about_the_game:
Space Cat Solitaire is a euphoric and satisfying puzzle card game adventure. With cats.

Gone are the boring, luck-of-the-draw deals. Gone are the mindless hours of repetitive gameplay. Gone are the green felt tables and generic playing cards. 

My team of scientists and I have carefully removed the green felt and replaced it with the cold dead vacuum of space. BUT WE DIDN'T STOP THERE. New cards with bright vibrant colors. Music that swells as you play. Mechanics that change with every deal. A range of difficulties. Cats.

Yes, cats! Cats to customize, cats on cards, cat puns, and cats who will take you along on their zany adventures.

Planning, puzzling and organizing have never been this enjoyable!

Play It Your Way

Some days you want to chill in a sunbeam. Other days you're up for a back-alley brawl. Whether you're looking to knock out some easy wins or slip into a deep puzzle-coma, we've got you covered! Whatever challenge you choose, unlimited undos give you the flexibility to retry any deal.

Win Fabulous Prizes

Get rewarded for your work! Unlock trophies for completing special challenges, or spend your earnings on customizations for your very own space kitten!

Enjoy The Journey

From the relaxing sights and sounds of reorganizing your cards, to the unleashing of a massive combo, to the fanfare of a victory, Space Cat Solitaire is a treat for your lazor-eyes and tufty-ears.

A Supernova of Content

  • Tons of mechanics and difficulties for a fresh experience every deal.

  • Adventure mode: a true roguelike experience featuring a multi-mission expedition! Navigate an ever-increasing difficulty with the use of your powerups in this high-risk / high-reward game mode.

  • Player stats & charts to record your triumphs. Share (or brag) to your friends (and their cats)!

  • Unlockable trophies and cosmetics to customize your very own Space Kitten!

  • Story-driven missions: unique unlockable episodic challenges following Space Kitten's first big adventure in space

  • Space. And cats. And solitaire.

About the Developer

Hello and welcome to the mid-life crisis also known as "my first game". For decades I've worked in data & analytics, worn just about every hat, worked for soul-crushing corpos and small businesses, and at each and every job I've struggled with one thing: how to find more meaning to my work. It took layoffs and a severance check to finally try something that had been childhood dream: to make my own video game. I learned to (actually) code, learned Unity, Illustrator, Audacity, Photoshop, and more. Space Cat Solitaire is the result! It's not my "dream game" but it does combine many of my loves and passions, like Cats, space, storytelling and (of course) solving puzzles.

If you've made it this far, I invite you to join the Gray Duck Games Discord, share some pictures of your cats or memes with like-minded friends! :)
